description: PARTNERING AND COMMUNICATING TOGETHER - PROJECT TITLE:PARTNERING AND COMMUNICATING TOGETHERAPPLICANT NAME: REALISTIC EDUCATION IN ACTION COALITION TO FOSTER HEALTH ? REACH LAADDRESS:1400 E. OLYMPIC BLVD #240, LOS ANGELES, CA 90021DIRECTOR:MIGUEL BUJANDA, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR CONTACT PHONE: (213) 622-1650 EXT 101E?MAIL ADDRESS:MIGUEL@REACHLA.ORG WEB SITE ADDRESS:WWW.REACHLA.ORGFUNDS REQUESTED:$200,000 PER YEAR ($1,000,000-5 YEARS)REALISTIC EDUCATION IN ACTION COALITION TO FOSTER HEALTH (REACH LA) IS APPLYING FOR PS21-2104 PARTNERING AND COMMUNICATING TOGETHER TO DISSEMINATE HIV COMMUNICATION RESOURCES VIA DIGITAL AND SOCIAL MEDIA CHANNELS TO INCREASE HIV AWARENESS, REDUCE NEW HIV INFECTIONS, AND IMPROVE HEALTH OUTCOMES AMONG LATINX AND BLACK GAY/BISEXUAL MEN AND TRANSGENDER WOMEN, AND PEOPLE LIVING WITH HIV IN LOS ANGELES COUNTY, A PHASE 1 ENDING THE HIV EPIDEMIC INITIATIVE JURISDICTION. REACH LA, A YOUTH-FOCUSED ORGANIZATION, WILL PARTNER WITH 30 BLACK AND LATINX INFLUENCERS IN THE HOUSE AND BALL, LATINO PARTY, ARTS, AND ENTERTAINMENT SCENES REACHING OVER 2.5 MILLION VIA SOCIAL MEDIA AND DIGITAL ADVERTISING YEARLY.  ON A YEARLY BASIS, REACH LA WILL CONDUCT 145 SOCIAL MEDIA POSTS, HOST 12 SOCIAL MEDIA EVENTS COHOSTED WITH BLACK AND LATINX LGBTQ INFLUENCERS, PLACEMENT OF 140 DIGITAL ADS ACROSS DIFFERENT SOCIAL MEDIA PLATFORMS, PARTNER WITH 20 COMMUNITY ORGANIZATIONS, AND PUBLISH 5 DIGITAL ARTICLES ON WEBSITES AND BLOGS. THE PARTNERSHIP WITH IHEART MEDIA FOR DIGITAL, RADIO, AND SOCIAL MEDIA WILL LEND ITS MAINSTREAM MEDIA INFLUENCE TO FURTHER REACH A LARGER AUDIENCE AS WELL AS CONNECT VIEWERS AND LISTENERS TO CDC FOR RESOURCES.REACH LA HAS ESTABLISHED A STRONG SOCIAL MEDIA PRESENCE AND ENGAGEMENT GEOTARGETING AND REACHING THE DOWNTOWN LOS ANGELES AREA (SPA 4), SOUTH LA (SPA 6), SAN FERNANDO VALLEY (SPA 2), AND SAN GABRIEL VALLEY (SPA 3).  FOLLOWERS AND PARTICIPANTS COME FROM SURROUNDING AREAS INCLUDING RIVERSIDE, SANTA ANA, AND POMONA. VIRTUALLY, PARTICIPANTS LOG INTO ZOOM WORKSHOPS AND DAN CE CLASSES FROM CHICAGO, LAS VEGAS, ORLANDO, AND MIAMI. AS OF MARCH 2021, DIGITAL AND SOCIAL MEDIA DATA REPORTED A TOTAL OF 3K FOLLOWERS ON INSTAGRAM 3.4K ON FACEBOOK. THERE IS CONSISTENT POSTING, ENGAGEMENT, AND KNOWLEDGE OF SOCIAL MEDIA ALGORITHMS THAT HAVE RESULTED IN TREMENDOUS ORGANIC SOCIAL MEDIA GROWTH. ADDITIONALLY, REACH LA HAS ESTABLISHED SYSTEMS TO RESPOND TO POSTS, TAGS, DIRECT MESSAGES, AND COMMENTS. REACH LA?S PS21-2104 SOCIAL MEDIA TEAM IS COMPRISED OF YOUNG AND TALENTED INFLUENCERS IN THE HOUSE AND BALL, MUSIC, LIFESTYLE WHO TOGETHER REACH 500,000 FOLLOWERS.  WITH A GREATER ONLINE PRESENCE AS A RESULT OF COVID-19, REACH LA HAD 1250+ INDIVIDUALS ATTEND THE VIRTUAL EVENTS, 650+ ATTEND VIRTUAL DANCE CLASSES, 535 YOUNG PEOPLE TESTED FOR HIV, 20 NEW POSITIVES IDENTIFIED, AND 100% LINKED TO CARE.REACH LA WILL UTILIZE SPROUTS SOCIAL FOR SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT AND DATA ANALYTICS THAT PROVIDES CROSS-CHANNEL SOCIAL MEDIA ANALYTICS, TREND MANAGEMENT, STREAMLINES AND SCALES POSTS AND ENGAGEMENT, MEASURES AND OPTIMIZES POSTS AND ADS. DATA ANALYTICS THAT INCLUDES NUMBER OF FOLLOWERS, NUMBER OF SOCIAL MEDIA POSTS, NUMBER OF ENGAGEMENT, NUMBER OF IMPRESSIONS FOR AD PLACEMENTS, NUMBER OF BLOG POSTS AND ENGAGEMENTS, NUMBER OF SEARCHES AND LINKAGES TO HIV SERVICES WILL BE REVIEWED MONTHLY TO IMPROVE PROGRAM PERFORMANCE.
